task: Write a short team message with these seven constraints: (1) 132 to 132 words inclusive; a word is a match of [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?, so punctuation is not a word. (2) Include the whole word "linen" ignoring case. (3) Do not use the whole word "always" ignoring case. (4) No digits. (5) Exactly 2 nonempty paragraphs separated by a blank line. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".

candidate.text:
Dear team,

Just a quick update regarding the upcoming client presentation. We’ve made excellent progress refining the core messaging and visual elements. The design team has incorporated the client's feedback on the colour palette, and the final slides are looking polished. Remember to review the talking points document one last time, focusing on how we articulate the value proposition. We're aiming for a presentation that feels both professional and approachable, reflecting the quality of our work and the beautiful linen textures we've proposed for their new product line. It’s vital that we present a unified front and demonstrate our collaborative spirit.

Let's meet briefly tomorrow morning to do a final run-through. Please come prepared to share any last-minute thoughts or questions. I'm confident that we'll deliver a compelling presentation and secure this important partnership. Remember, preparation is key and your dedication is greatly appreciated. We will succeed with strong teamwork and focused effort. 

Kind regards.
